verdict.rationale: Undermind publishes an official hosted MCP server (mcp.undermind.ai/mcp) with documented setup instructions for Cursor, VS Code, Claude, and any MCP-compatible client, plus specific tool capabilities (literature review, PDF Q&A, notes, curation). This is first-party documentation with concrete transport/endpoint details, confirmed by probe evidence of the docs page existing. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community confirmation specifically of MCP connectivity (community evidence only covers the web search product, not MCP usage) and no public API schema (openapi probes 404).
